source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"This particular concern lacking any established, evidence-based prevention strategies that could realistically help address it in clinical practice","B":"Precautions considered relevant mainly during the surgical procedure itself, rather than continuing on throughout the client's entire ongoing recovery","C":"Appropriately timed prophylactic antibiotics, strict sterile technique, and ongoing monitoring for signs of infection given the significant morbidity of prosthetic joint infection","D":"Fairly few special precautions actually being needed at all beyond what standard surgical care would already typically provide for any given client"}}
source_row.rationale: Joint replacement infection prevention includes appropriately timed prophylactic antibiotics, strict sterile technique throughout the perioperative period, and ongoing monitoring for signs of infection, given the significant morbidity (including potential need for revision surgery) associated with prosthetic joint infection.
source_row.source_detail: Comprehensive Infection Prevention for Joint Replacement
source_row.source_name: AAOS — Prosthetic Joint Infection Prevention Guidelines
